fragment.choose:
<when condition="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestedModel", "") != "non-llm-request")">
            
                
                
                
                
                <dimension name="deploymentName" value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestedModel", "DefaultModel"))" />
                
                
                
                
                
                <dimension name="appId" value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("appId", context.Subscription?.Id ?? "Portal-Admin-Sub"))" />

                
                <dimension name="customDimension1" value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("customDimension1", "NA"))" />

                
                <dimension name="customDimension2" value="@{
                    var explicitValue = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("customDimension2", "");
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(explicitValue)) { return explicitValue; }
                    if (context.Variables.ContainsKey("validated-jwt")) {
                        var jwt = (Jwt)context.Variables["validated-jwt"];
                        var preferred = jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("preferred_username", "");
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(preferred)) { return preferred; }
                        var upn = jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("upn", "");
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(upn)) { return upn; }
                        var email = jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("email", "");
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(email)) { return email; }
                    }
                    return "NA";
                }" />
